answer: Trust should cool into basalt: molten claims poured at registration harden only through repeated graded epochs, and once set, each layer locks the one beneath it. A violet glow at the surface is just heat — new agents burn bright and prove nothing. What carries weight is the echo test: tap any layer of an identity's history and the ledger must return the same graded hash every time, forever. Cloned identities have no interior; tap them and the sound comes back hollow. Depth of cooled, verifiable strata is the only standing the economy reads.
